topic: Machine Learning Model Deployment and REST APIs
learningObjectives: Explain how a trained machine learning model is exposed through an API.
Design a basic REST API workflow for model predictions.
Connect an application to a deployed machine learning endpoint.

activities.title: Deployment Pipeline
activities.instruction: Explore the path from a trained model to a prediction returned to an application.

content.concept: Model deployment makes a trained model available to applications through a serving layer such as a REST API.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

descriptions: The trained model saved for inference.
Loads the model and handles prediction requests.
A URL through which applications send prediction requests.
Sends input data to the deployed endpoint.
Contains the model's prediction and related response data.

activities.title: API Anatomy
activities.instruction: Identify the main components of a REST prediction API.

content.concept: A prediction API receives structured input, validates it, performs inference, and returns a structured response.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

descriptions: Defines the operation, such as POST for sending prediction data.
The URL path that receives prediction requests.
Contains the input features sent by the client.
Checks that incoming data has the expected structure and values.
Uses the trained model to generate a prediction.
Returns the prediction and relevant information to the client.

activities.title: Request Builder
activities.instruction: Build a valid request for a model prediction endpoint.

content.concept: A client sends structured feature values to a prediction endpoint, usually using an HTTP POST request with JSON data.
